title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Padding and Traffic Analysis Work Item
summary: Add EDNS(0) padding injection via DoqPadding class, integrate in DoqClient and DoqServer, configure via DoqDefaults and DoqServerOptions.
planned_changes:
- Add DoqPadding static class with PadMessage method for EDNS(0) padding injection.
- Add DoqDefaults.PaddingBlockSize (default 128).
- Add DoqServerOptions.PaddingBlockSize (defaults to DoqDefaults.PaddingBlockSize).
- Integrate padding in DoqClient.QueryAsync before DoQ encoding.
- Integrate padding in DoqServer.HandleQueryStreamAsync before DoQ encoding.
- Add focused tests: padding boundaries, padding-only payload, oversized padding, max-message-size interaction, disabled padding.
- Link REQ-0125 (traffic analysis mitigation) to the padding implementation.
verification_plan: Run DoQ foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Full DNS parsing beyond what is needed for padding insertion.
completion_notes: All 5 REQs are now traced and verified. Padding is implemented and integrated.
